summary: The red team reports no findings, so there is no verdict to give. I tested its clean result, and every claim I tested holds. The accepted map (promoted copy byte-identical) has 47 links, 3 explicit incoming and 44 inferred outgoing, and 11 overlaps. All 171 evidence quotations are literal in their stage descriptions or roadmap documents, new-roadmap definitions included. In the production graph (scripts.build.assemble: 2840 stages, 8007 edges), 42 links are live and the other 5, to MordellLawrenceVenkatesh LV.0/2/4/6/7, sit in deferredLinks awaiting that roadmap. I also probed the failure mode found in two other link maps, an edge delegated to a host that never reached the atlas. This map has no alreadyRecorded or deduplicated entries. Of its five removedLinks, three target the retired FoundationsAndLibraryIntegration LI.4; LFR Layer 4 → LefschetzPencils LPV.1 remains reachable by a path; and LFR Layer 2 → LV.1 was rightly removed, because the current LV.1 no longer names LocalFieldsRamification in its text or its requires. No new observation.
checks: Independence: this reviewer did none of LINK-, REV-LINK- or RT-LINK-tauceti_TauCetiRoadmap_LocalFieldsRamification.
Counts, directions and confidences recomputed from the packet; research and data/links copies compared byte for byte.
All 171 link and overlap quotations checked against stage descriptions and roadmap documents (data/atlas.json sourcePath, and research/blueprint/roadmaps/*.json for new roadmaps); none fails.
Liveness: 42/47 links in the assembled stageEdges; the remaining 5 are exactly the LV targets listed in atlas.deferredLinks.

removedLinks: every removed pair checked against the assembled graph and the target's current text and requires, including MordellLawrenceVenkatesh LV.1 (research/blueprint/roadmaps/MordellLawrenceVenkatesh.json).
